roles.name: type-declaration
roles.hint: Ambient type declaration: no runtime behaviour to score.

roles.name: generated
roles.hint: Generated code: not hand-written, not scored.

roles.name: story
roles.hint: Storybook story: illustrative component usage, not production runtime code.

roles.name: test
roles.hint: Test code: exercises behaviour; light error handling is expected.

roles.name: mock
roles.hint: Mock/stub: stand-in for a real dependency, not production logic.

roles.name: fixture
roles.hint: Fixture: static test input, not runtime logic.

roles.name: migration
roles.hint: DB migration: sequential and append-only, verified by running them, not unit tests.
